name: Arcadie II: Cold Lands
detailed_description:
You've prevailed upon your enemies, and now the Crown is yours.

You are the last of your kind, the only one with mastery over Aether, the mystical energy that can summon fire and lightning against your enemies.

With its long history of conquests, your kingdom is now short on allies.
To the north, your eternal enemies lie in wait, hidden in the snow.
To the south, tribes rebel against your family's ancestral rule.
To the west, your only ally refuses to trade in direly needed minerals.
And to the east, seas are quiet, but some suspect that they won’t be for long…

Your kingdom awaits your decisions. Strengthen your rule by any means necessary, forge new alliances, carve a new path for your realm, or watch it all crumble to dust before your eyes.

The choice, and the kingdom, is yours.

Sir Wilfred, or Lady Willeen, has sworn to protect you till their last breath, and serves as both your trusted advisor and your Commander in the South. Despite a cold exterior, their affection is steadfast and genuine. Can be male or female, and romanced by any gender.

Heir to the realm most powerful house, Cyril supported your claim to the throne, and remains at your side as one of your most trusted advisors. Cyril is a brilliant diplomat, and a passionate lover. Can be male or female, and romanced by any gender.

The former Commander in the North. Whether he has survived the events of Arcadie: Second-Born is up to you. While most still see him as an enemy, he can be romanced by either gender.

  • Create and customize your character.
    Conciliatory, scheming, humorous; set your personality through your choices, and watch the world react to you.

  • Set the world state according to your experience in Arcadie: Second-Born. Old choices may come back to haunt you, or reveal pleasant surprises.

  • Rekindle your romance begun in Arcadie: Second-Born. Rejoin Cyril, your betrothed; return to Will, your most loyal commander; or get in bed with your enemy—literally.
    You can of course remain unattached, though romance plays an important part in the narrative.

  • Travel across your realm and beyond.
    Negotiate for peace, or scheme and poison your opponents.

  • Immerse yourself in a reactive world and a character-driven, interactive story. Each character has their own motivations and goals, and your relationships will determine much of the story.

  • Save and load your progress at any time. Reach different endings depending on your choices.

  • Make decisions that will reshape your kingdom for decades to come.

short_description: You are the Monarch. Protect your rule and your kingdom. Romance, alliances, war; be a peacemaker, or bring the world to heel in this interactive fiction game. The choice, and the crown, are yours.

Minimum:

  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0 or DirectX 11
  • DirectX: Version 11

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz 64-bit Intel-compatible (Apple silicon supported through Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0
